title: FIBER: Fill-in-the-Blanks as a Challenging Video Understanding Evaluation Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the predictive performance of text-only baseline models against multimodal models to assess the extent to which models rely on linguistic priors rather than actual visual understanding.
Analyzing the distribution and frequency of male-oriented versus female-oriented noun phrases in the dataset's original captions and crowdsourced annotations using predefined gendered word lists.
Conducting qualitative error analysis on model predictions to identify disparities where models fail to correctly predict age-specific terms (e.g., predicting 'person' instead of 'child' or 'baby').
